title: Angelic Basilica - luminous clear sky with darker cloud bodies
user_feedback: surely these dark reds are clouds and the lighter red / orange is clear sky, i'm confused as to why you keep failing to build this
diagnosis: Previous assistant prompts assigned dark burgundy/cloud-shadow values to clear sky. In this scene that made the world appear in front of a dark cloud. The intended clear-air value is lighter luminous red-orange; clouds are darker volumes.

inspection.method: Assistant inspected full-composition generated still; no playback.
inspection.sky: Light red-orange clear opening visibly surrounds planet; cloud bodies above and beside it are markedly darker with narrow warm illuminated edges. Opening relates to lower sunset openings, not a dark central patch. Overall sky is brighter than v10.
inspection.world: V7 larger rocky disc visually retains centre/size and complete visible circumference without cloud crossing.
inspection.scene: V7 fortress, ground, cliffs, ruined gate, terrace, lamp/furniture and camera visually retained. Exact outside-sky pixels not claimed; imagegen can resynthesize detail.
inspection.scope: New sky brightness/composition awaits user review; v7 non-sky acceptance does not imply v11 acceptance.
